open_questions.text: Should templates for the College's twelve most used forms be included, and what are their specific formats?
What is the migration scope and data volume for the signed records held in the current tool by 2027-02-28?
How should the optional on-premises deployment option be priced and architected?
What support channels and escalation paths are required to meet the one-hour response time for severity-one incidents at any time of day?
What is the expected schema and rate limit for the College's existing REST API referenced in REQ-0009?
Does the target go-live date of 2027-01-11 allow for a phased rollout to specific student cohorts, or must all students be supported simultaneously?

approach.text: Bid compliance: assemble the proposal as a single PDF, verify it meets the 20-page limit, and submit it via the procurement portal before 2026-12-01 12:00 UTC. Ensure the service goes live for students by the first day of spring enrollment on 2027-01-11.
approach.basis: The instructions mandate the submission format, page limit, deadline, and live date. Portal reliability is assumed.

approach.text: Signature audit and retention: maintain an audit record of every signature event, capturing signer identity, time, and document version, and store signed documents for ten years.
approach.basis: The audit elements and the ten-year retention period are explicitly defined in the requirements.

approach.text: Browser compatibility and reminders: support signing across current desktop and mobile browsers, and send an automated reminder to any signer who has not completed signing within 72 hours.
approach.basis: Browser support and the 72-hour reminder timeframe are explicitly stated.

approach.text: System integration and availability: integrate the service with the College's student records system using its existing REST API, and maintain 99.5% monthly availability excluding planned maintenance announced five working days in advance.
approach.basis: The integration method and availability metrics, along with maintenance notice periods, are specified.

risks.condition: Requirement REQ-0014 mandates that the service go live by 2027-01-11, leaving only 41 days from contract award assuming a 2026-12-01 award date.
risks.event: Integration with the student records system via REST API (REQ-0009) encounters unexpected authentication or schema hurdles, delaying go-live past 2027-01-11.
risks.effect: The service fails to launch for students on the first day of spring enrollment, breaching contract terms.
assumptions: The College's existing REST API is fully documented and immediately accessible upon contract award.
risks.trigger: API documentation is not provided within three days of contract award.
responses: Request API documentation and sandbox access prior to contract award.
Prepare a fallback manual roster import mechanism if API integration is delayed.
risks.residual_exposure: Manual import requires operational overhead and risks student friction during spring enrollment.

risks.condition: Requirement REQ-0008 suggests migrating signed records held in the current tool by 2027-02-28, which is after the student go-live date of 2027-01-11.
risks.event: Support staff attempt to access historical signed records during the spring enrollment period before migration is finished, and cannot find them in the new system.
risks.effect: Administrative delays and compliance confusion occur when staff must query two separate systems during enrollment.
assumptions: Users will tolerate checking the legacy tool for historical records until the end of February 2027.
risks.trigger: Migration script testing reveals data format mismatches from the legacy tool.
responses: Prioritize migration of the most frequently accessed form templates before 2027-01-11.
Provide staff with clear documentation on how to access legacy archives.
risks.residual_exposure: Staff time is wasted navigating dual systems until full migration completes on 2027-02-28.
